name: replaylist
description: Transfer playlists between Spotify and YouTube

scripts.dev:tauri: concurrently "cd backend && python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build:backend: pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt pyinstaller && pyinstaller backend/pyinstaller.spec --noconfirm
scripts.postbuild:backend: if not exist tauri\binaries mkdir tauri\binaries && copy /Y dist\replaylist-backend\replaylist-backend.exe tauri\binaries\replaylist-backend.exe
scripts.build:app: npm run build:backend && cd tauri && npm run tauri build
